reason: I only really have Saturdays with my kid, so an unlimited membership would get maybe 4 uses a month, and at that rate drop-in at $12 is cheaper than $59. It's also a drive for us and gas adds up, so I wouldn't commit to it before seeing it in person.
objection: Weekends only means I'd use it 3 or 4 times a month at most, so a membership doesn't pay off, and the drive plus gas makes each visit cost more than the ticket. It's also not open yet.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or 4-visit pass at about $30, or confirmation that it's a short drive from me and the first Saturday I try is good.
